## Should We Invest in Solar?

Excel-based investment analysis and professional judgement.

Use Microsoft Excel to compare three solar investment proposals, test financial assumptions and develop an evidence-based management recommendation.

- **Duration:** 65–80 minutes
- **Level:** Beginner
- **Format:** Self-paced online activity
- **Software:** Microsoft Excel
- **Cost:** Free

[View course](/Courses/solar-investment/index.qmd){.btn-p}

## Designed to make evidence visible. {.sec-h}

Each activity is structured to help learners compare alternatives, test assumptions, recognise uncertainty and reach a reasoned recommendation. The focus remains on evidence, judgement and professional decision-making.
